senses.gloss:
अप्सरस् f. plur. always (-राः) The nymphs of Svarga, attendants on INDRA.
E. अप् water, सृ to go, and असि Unādi affix: or अप्स in the waters,
and रस flavour: from their fondness for bathing, or from their
being produced at the churning of the ocean.

अप्सरा f. (-रा) an Apsarā or heavenly nymph.
 E. अप् and सृ as before,
with अच् aff.
